title: Lusin compact exhaustion of a finite-measure set in ℝ^{n+ℓ}
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ} with its Borel σ-algebra, μ any measure on E, A ⊆ E a μ-null-measurable set with μ(A) < ∞, and g : E → ℝ a function that is a.e.-strongly measurable with respect to μ⌞A. Then there are compact sets K_k ⊆ A (k ∈ ℕ) such that g restricted to each K_k is continuous (ContinuousOn g K_k) and μ(A ∖ ⋃_k K_k) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (A : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet A μ → μ A ≠ ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μ.restrict A) → ∃ K : ℕ → Set (Ambient n ℓ), (∀ k, IsCompact (K k) ∧ K k ⊆ A ∧ ContinuousOn g (K k)) ∧ μ (A \ ⋃ k, K k) = 0
